messages.subject: Re: Correspondence analysis- Need help for my first shiny App
parts:
Abhishek,
It is not an issue with shiny but with how CA  is being used. So, this question technically doesn't belong in this forum. [It would be a good idea to see if the code works out of the shiny environment before wrapping it up with the ui and server.] But to address it, here's what needs to be done.

1. The error is as it suggests... X is not quantitative because it is the column with attributes (in chr). 
2. Store that column X values as row.names and delete X as a column in the df (or ignore that column when using CA)

Here's your modified server file that should work.

library (FactoMineR)
library (shiny)
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  output$caPlot <- renderPlot({
    inFile <- input$df
    if (is.null(inFile))
      return(NULL)
    dataset<-read.csv(inFile$
                        datapath, header=T, stringsAsFactors =F)

row.names(dataset)=dataset[,1]
    dataset[,1]=NULL ### Not required if the call below is CA(dataset[,-1],graph=FALSE)

ca2 = CA(dataset, graph = FALSE) 
    plot(ca2)
    
  })
})
